operationName: Ebola PHEIC Response — 2026 Bundibugyo Outbreak, DRC & Uganda
heroHeadline: Ebola Cases Surpass 8,000 in DRC: 8,067 Confirmed, 3,901 Deaths
heroSubtitle: The DRC public health institute's 28 September report put the Bundibugyo outbreak at 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths (crude CFR 48.4%), with Ituri still the epicenter at 6,032 cases and 893 patients in isolation. Al Jazeera reports low treatment capacity in Ituri, a vaccine shortage in Tshopo and a Butembo hotspot in North Kivu, while WHO warns the outbreak is far from over and could surpass the 2014-16 West Africa epidemic.
footerNote: Data sourced from DRC Ministry of Health (MSANTE) situation reports, ECDC outbreak tracker, WHO Disease Outbreak News, Africa CDC statements, Uganda Ministry of Health, CDC Ebola Situation Summary, MSF, AP, AFP, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, Healio, and UN News. Case counts are rapidly evolving.
